description: This file defines the CustomFieldDao class, responsible for managing custom field entities in the OrangeHRM system, including saving, deleting, retrieving, and searching custom fields, as well as updating employee records based on custom field usage.

classes.name: CustomFieldDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing CustomField entities, including CRUD operations and search functionalities.

methods.name: saveCustomField
methods.description: Saves a CustomField entity, assigning a unique field number if necessary, and persists it in the database with transactional safety.

methods.name: getCustomFieldById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomField by its ID (field number).

methods.name: getExistingCustomFieldIds
methods.description: Checks for existing custom fields matching a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteCustomFields
methods.description: Deletes custom fields and their associated display fields from the database within a transaction.

methods.name: searchCustomField
methods.description: Performs a search for custom fields based on specified filter parameters and returns the results.

methods.name: getSearchCustomFieldPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator object for paginated search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchCustomFieldsCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of custom fields matching specific search filters.

methods.name: isCustomFieldInUse
methods.description: Checks if a custom field is referenced in any Employee records.

methods.name: updateEmployeesIfDropDownValueInUse
methods.description: Clears the custom field value for employees if the drop-down value is in use, for a specified custom field.
